NKJV.1: Now it came to pass, a long time after the LORD had given rest to Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua was old, advanced in age.
NKJV.2: And Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers, and said to them: “I am old, advanced in age.
NKJV.3: You have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you, for the LORD your God is He who has fought for you.
NKJV.4: See, I have divided to you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, as far as the Great Sea westward.
NKJV.5: And the LORD your God will expel them from before you and drive them out of your sight. So you shall possess their land, as the LORD your God promised you.
NKJV.6: Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, lest you turn aside from it to the right hand or to the left,
NKJV.7: and lest you go among these nations, these who remain among you. You shall not make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause anyone to swear by them; you shall not serve them nor bow down to them,
NKJV.8: but you shall hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
NKJV.9: For the LORD has driven out from before you great and strong nations; but as for you, no one has been able to stand against you to this day.
NKJV.10: One man of you shall chase a thousand, for the LORD your God is He who fights for you, as He promised you.
NKJV.11: Therefore take careful heed to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God.
NKJV.12: Or else, if indeed you do go back, and cling to the remnant of these nations—these that remain among you—and make marriages with them, and go in to them and they to you,
NKJV.13: know for certain that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations from before you. But they shall be snares and traps to you, and scourges on your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
NKJV.14: “Behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth. And you know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have come to pass for you; not one word of them has failed.
NKJV.15: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all the good things have come upon you which the LORD your God promised you, so the LORD will bring upon you all harmful things, until He has destroyed you from this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
NKJV.16: When you have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you shall perish quickly from the good land which He has given you.”

NASB.1: Now it came about after many days, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from all their enemies on every side, and Joshua was old, advanced in years,
NASB.2: that Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and their heads and their judges and their officers, and said to them, 'I am old, advanced in years.
NASB.3: 'And you have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you, for the LORD your God is He who has been fighting for you.
NASB.4: 'See, I have apportioned to you these nations which remain as an inheritance for your tribes, with all the nations which I have cut off, from the Jordan even to the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun.
NASB.5: 'The LORD your God, He will thrust them out from before you and drive them from before you; and you will possess their land, just as the LORD your God promised you.
NASB.6: 'Be very firm, then, to keep and do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, so that you may not turn aside from it to the right hand or to the left,
NASB.7: so that you will not associate with these nations, these which remain among you, or mention the name of their gods, or make [anyone] swear [by them], or serve them, or bow down to them.
NASB.8: 'But you are to cling to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
NASB.9: 'For the LORD has driven out great and strong nations from before you; and as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.
NASB.10: 'One of your men puts to flight a thousand, for the LORD your God is He who fights for you, just as He promised you.
NASB.11: 'So take diligent heed to yourselves to love the LORD your God.
NASB.12: 'For if you ever go back and cling to the rest of these nations, these which remain among you, and intermarry with them, so that you associate with them and they with you,
NASB.13: know with certainty that the LORD your God will not continue to drive these nations out from before you; but they will be a snare and a trap to you, and a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
NASB.14: 'Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one word of all the good words which the LORD your God spoke concerning you has failed; all have been fulfilled for you, not one of them has failed.
NASB.15: 'It shall come about that just as all the good words which the LORD your God spoke to you have come upon you, so the LORD will bring upon you all the threats, until He has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
NASB.16: 'When you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which He has given you.'

ESV.1: A long time afterward, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from all their surrounding enemies, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,
ESV.2: Joshua summoned all Israel, its elders and heads, its judges and officers, and said to them, “I am now old and well advanced in years.
ESV.3: And you have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake, for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you.
ESV.4: Behold, I have allotted to you as an inheritance for your tribes those nations that remain, along with all the nations that I have already cut off, from the Jordan to the Great Sea in the west.
ESV.5: The LORD your God will push them back before you and drive them out of your sight. And you shall possess their land, just as the LORD your God promised you.
ESV.6: Therefore, be very strong to keep and to do all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, turning aside from it neither to the right hand nor to the left,
ESV.7: that you may not mix with these nations remaining among you or make mention of the names of their gods or swear by them or serve them or bow down to them,
ESV.8: but you shall cling to the LORD your God just as you have done to this day.

ESV.11: Be very careful, therefore, to love the LORD your God.
ESV.12: For if you turn back and cling to the remnant of these nations remaining among you and make marriages with them, so that you associate with them and they with you,
ESV.13: know for certain that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you, but they shall be a snare and a trap for you, a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good ground that the LORD your God has given you.
ESV.14: “And now I am about to go the way of all the earth, and you know in your hearts and souls, all of you, that not one word has failed of all the good things  that the LORD your God promised concerning you. All have come to pass for you; not one of them has failed.
ESV.15: But just as all the good things that the LORD your God promised concerning you have been fulfilled for you, so the LORD will bring upon you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land that the LORD your God has given you,
ESV.16: if you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them. Then the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land that he has given to you.”

NLT.1: The years passed, and the LORD had given the people of Israel rest from all their enemies. Joshua, who was now very old,
NLT.2: called together all the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel. He said to them, “I am now a very old man.
NLT.3: You have seen everything the LORD your God has done for you during my lifetime. The LORD your God has fought for you against your enemies.
NLT.4: I have allotted to you as your homeland all the land of the nations yet unconquered, as well as the land of those we have already conquered — from the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
NLT.5: This land will be yours, for the LORD your God will himself drive out all the people living there now. You will take possession of their land, just as the LORD your God promised you.
NLT.6: “So be very careful to follow everything Moses wrote in the Book of Instruction. Do not deviate from it, turning either to the right or to the left.
NLT.7: Make sure you do not associate with the other people still remaining in the land. Do not even mention the names of their gods, much less swear by them or serve them or worship them.
NLT.8: Rather, cling tightly to the LORD your God as you have done until now.
NLT.9: “For the LORD has driven out great and powerful nations for you, and no one has yet been able to defeat you.
NLT.10: Each one of you will put to flight a thousand of the enemy, for the LORD your God fights for you, just as he has promised.
NLT.11: So be very careful to love the LORD your God.
NLT.12: “But if you turn away from him and cling to the customs of the survivors of these nations remaining among you, and if you intermarry with them,
NLT.13: then know for certain that the LORD your God will no longer drive them out of your land. Instead, they will be a snare and a trap to you, a whip for your backs and thorny brambles in your eyes, and you will vanish from this good land the LORD your God has given you.
NLT.14: “Soon I will die, going the way of everything on earth. Deep in your hearts you know that every promise of the LORD your God has come true. Not a single one has failed!
NLT.15: But as surely as the LORD your God has given you the good things he promised, he will also bring disaster on you if you disobey him. He will completely destroy you from this good land he has given you.
NLT.16: If you break the covenant of the LORD your God by worshiping and serving other gods, his anger will burn against you, and you will quickly vanish from the good land he has given you.”

CSB17.1: A long time after the LORD had given Israel rest from all the enemies around them, <sup>ⓔ</sup> Joshua was old, advanced in age. <sup>ⓕ</sup>
CSB17.2: So Joshua summoned all Israel, including its elders, leaders, judges, and officers, <sup>ⓖ</sup> and said to them, “I am old, advanced in age,
CSB17.3: and you have seen for yourselves everything the LORD your God did to all these nations on your account, because it was the LORD your God who was fighting for you. <sup>ⓗ</sup>
CSB17.4: See, I have allotted these remaining nations to you as an inheritance for your tribes, <sup>ⓘ</sup> including all the nations I have destroyed, from the Jordan westward to the Mediterranean Sea.
CSB17.5: The LORD your God will force them back on your account and drive them out before you so that you can take possession of their land, <sup>ⓙ</sup> as the LORD your God promised you.
CSB17.6: “Be very strong <sup>ⓚ</sup> and continue obeying all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, so that you do not turn from it to the right or left
CSB17.7: and so that you do not associate with these nations remaining among you. Do not call on the names of their gods or make an oath to them; <sup>ⓛ</sup> do not serve them or bow in worship to them.
CSB17.8: Instead, be loyal to the LORD your God, as you have been to this day. <sup>ⓜ</sup>
CSB17.9: “The LORD has driven out great and powerful nations before you, <sup>ⓝ</sup> and no one is able to stand against you to this day. <sup>ⓐ</sup>
CSB17.10: One of you routed a thousand <sup>ⓑ</sup> because the LORD your God was fighting for you, as he promised. <sup>[1]</sup> <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.11: So diligently watch yourselves! Love the LORD your God!
CSB17.12: If you ever turn away and become loyal to the rest of these nations remaining among you, <sup>ⓓ</sup> and if you intermarry or associate with them <sup>ⓔ</sup> and they with you,
CSB17.13: know for certain that the LORD your God will not continue to drive these nations out before you. They will become a snare and a trap for you, <sup>ⓕ</sup> a sharp stick <sup>[2]</sup> for your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you disappear from this good land the LORD your God has given you.
CSB17.14: “I am now going the way of the whole earth, <sup>ⓖ</sup> and you know with all your heart and all your soul that none of the good promises the LORD your God made to you has failed. Everything was fulfilled for you; not one promise has failed. <sup>ⓗ</sup>
CSB17.15: Since every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come about, so he will bring on you every bad thing until he has annihilated you from this good land the LORD your God has given you. <sup>ⓘ</sup>
CSB17.16: If you break the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow in worship to them, the LORD’s anger will burn against you, and you will quickly disappear from this good land he has given you.”

AMP.1: A long time after that, when the LORD had given Israel rest from all their enemies on every side, and Joshua had grown old and advanced in years,
AMP.2: that Joshua called all Israel, their elders and their heads and their judges and their officers, and said to them, "I am old and advanced in years.
AMP.3: And you have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake; for the LORD your God is He who has been fighting for you.
AMP.4: See, I have allotted to you these nations that remain as an inheritance for your tribes, with all the nations which I have cut off, from the Jordan [on the east] to the Great [Mediterranean] Sea toward the setting sun.
AMP.5: The LORD your God will push them away from before you and drive them out of your sight and you will take possession of their land, just as the LORD your God promised you.
AMP.6: Be steadfast and very determined to keep and to do everything that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, so that you do not turn aside from it to the right or the left,
AMP.7: so that you do not associate with these nations which remain among you, or mention the name of their gods, or make anyone swear [an oath by them], or serve them, or bow down to them.
AMP.8: But you are to cling to the LORD your God, just as you have done to this day.
AMP.9: For the LORD has driven out great and mighty nations from before you; and as for you, no man has been able to stand [in opposition] before you to this day.
AMP.10: One of your men puts to flight a thousand, for the LORD your God is He who is fighting for you, just as He promised you.
AMP.11: So be very careful and watchful of yourselves to love the LORD your God.
AMP.12: For if you ever turn back and cling to the rest of these nations, these that are left among you, and intermarry with them, so that you associate with them and they with you,
AMP.13: know and understand with certainty that the LORD your God will not continue to drive these nations out from before you; but they will be a snare and trap to you, and a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
AMP.14: "Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one word of all the good words which the LORD your God has promised concerning you has failed; all have been fulfilled for you, not one of them has failed.
AMP.15: It shall come about that just as every good word which the LORD your God spoke and promised to you has been fulfilled for you, so the LORD will bring upon you every bad thing [about which He warned you], until He has destroyed and eliminated you from this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
AMP.16: When you transgress (violate) the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you [to follow], and you go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from the good land which He has given you."

MSG.1: A long time later, after God had given Israel rest from all their surrounding enemies, and Joshua was a venerable old man,
MSG.2:
Joshua called all Israel together—elders, chiefs, judges, and officers. Then he spoke to them:
"I'm an old man. I've lived a long time.
MSG.3: You have seen everything that God has done to these nations because of you. He did it because he's God, your God. He fought for you.
MSG.4: "Stay alert: I have assigned to you by lot these nations that remain as an inheritance to your tribes—these in addition to the nations I have already cut down—from the Jordan to the Great Sea in the west.
MSG.5: God, your God, will drive them out of your path until there's nothing left of them and you'll take over their land just as God, your God, promised you.
MSG.6: "Now, stay strong and steady. Obediently do everything written in the Book of The Revelation of Moses—don't miss a detail.
MSG.7: Don't get mixed up with the nations that are still around. Don't so much as speak the names of their gods or swear by them. And by all means don't worship or pray to them.
MSG.8: Hold tight to God, your God, just as you've done up to now.
MSG.9: "God has driven out superpower nations before you. And up to now, no one has been able to stand up to you.
MSG.10: Think of it—one of you, single-handedly, putting a thousand on the run! Because God is God, your God. Because he fights for you, just as he promised you.
MSG.11: "Now, vigilantly guard your souls: Love God, your God.
MSG.12: Because if you wander off and start taking up with these remaining nations still among you (intermarry, say, and have other dealings with them),

NIV.1:
Joshua’s Farewell to the Leaders
After a long time had passed and the Lord had given Israel rest from all their enemies around them, Joshua, by then old and well advanced in years,
NIV.2: summoned all Israel—their elders, leaders, judges and officials—and said to them: “I am old and well advanced in years.
NIV.3: You yourselves have seen everything the Lord your God has done to all these nations for your sake; it was the Lord your God who fought for you.
NIV.4: Remember how I have allotted as an inheritance for your tribes all the land of the nations that remain—the nations I conquered—between the Jordan and the Great Sea in the west.
NIV.5: The Lord your God himself will drive them out of your way. He will push them out before you, and you will take possession of their land, as the Lord your God promised you.
NIV.6: “Be very strong; be careful to obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, without turning aside to the right or to the left.
NIV.7: Do not associate with these nations that remain among you; do not invoke the names of their gods or swear by them. You must not serve them or bow down to them.
NIV.8: But you are to hold fast to the Lord your God, as you have until now.
NIV.9: “The Lord has driven out before you great and powerful nations; to this day no one has been able to withstand you.
NIV.10: One of you routs a thousand, because the Lord your God fights for you, just as he promised.
NIV.11: So be very careful to love the Lord your God.
NIV.12: “But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you and if you intermarry with them and associate with them,
NIV.13: then you may be sure that the Lord your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become snares and traps for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land, which the Lord your God has given you.
NIV.14: “Now I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the Lord your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed.
NIV.15: But just as every good promise of the Lord your God has come true, so the Lord will bring on you all the evil he has threatened, until he has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.
NIV.16: If you violate the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, the Lord’s anger will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from the good land he has given you.”

NET.1: A long time passed after the LORD made Israel secure from all their enemies, and Joshua was very old.
NET.2: So Joshua summoned all Israel, including the elders, rulers, judges, and leaders, and told them: “I am very old.
NET.3: You saw everything the LORD your God did to all these nations on your behalf, for the LORD your God fights for you.
NET.4: See, I have parceled out to your tribes these remaining nations, from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea in the west, including all the nations I defeated.
NET.5: The LORD your God will drive them out from before you and remove them, so you can occupy their land as the LORD your God promised you.
NET.6: Be very strong! Carefully obey all that is written in the law scroll of Moses so you won’t swerve from it to the right or the left,
NET.7: or associate with these nations that remain near you. You must not invoke or make solemn declarations by the names of their gods! You must not worship or bow down to them!
NET.8: But you must be loyal to the LORD your God, as you have been to this very day.
NET.9: “The LORD drove out from before you great and mighty nations; no one has been able to resist you to this very day.
NET.10: One of you makes a thousand run away, for the LORD your God fights for you as he promised you he would.
NET.11: Watch yourselves carefully! Love the LORD your God!
NET.12: But if you ever turn away and make alliances with these nations that remain near you, and intermarry with them and establish friendly relations with them,
NET.13: know for certain that the LORD our God will no longer drive out these nations from before you. They will trap and ensnare you; they will be a whip that tears your sides and thorns that blind your eyes until you disappear from this good land the LORD your God gave you.
NET.14: “Look, today I am about to die. You know with all your heart and being that not even one of all the faithful promises the LORD your God made to you is left unfulfilled; every one was realized — not one promise is unfulfilled!
NET.15: But in the same way every faithful promise the LORD your God made to you has been realized, it is just as certain, if you disobey, that the LORD will bring on you every judgment until he destroys you from this good land which the LORD your God gave you.
NET.16: If you violate the covenantal laws of the LORD your God which he commanded you to keep, and follow, worship, and bow down to other gods, the LORD will be very angry with you and you will disappear quickly from the good land which he gave to you.”
